families.props: variant=default; size=default; type=button; native disabled; visible children or required icon/name
families.behaviour: Native button props/ref; at most one leading/trailing icon; IconButton excludes text variant.

families.props: href; children; presentation=inline|standalone (inline); trailingIcon
families.behaviour: Native anchor props/ref; no disabled/as/asChild; preserve navigation.

families.props: label; name; id?; helperText?; error?; requirement=required|optional; type=text; width=full|2ch|3ch|4ch|5ch|10ch|20ch (full)
families.behaviour: Native input props/ref, value/defaultValue/onChange; requirement and native required must agree. No placeholder or accessible-name override.

families.props: label; name; id?; helperText?; error?; requirement; rows=5
families.behaviour: Native textarea props/ref, value/defaultValue/onChange; vertical resize.

families.props: label; name; id?; helperText?; error?; requirement; children=option/optgroup
families.behaviour: Native single-select props/ref, value/defaultValue/onChange; no multiple/readOnly; React owns selected via value.

families.props: legend; legendStyle?; headingLevel?; helperText?; error?; errorAssociation=group|children (group); children
families.behaviour: Native fieldset props/ref; legend first direct child. In children mode error.id is supplied to affected controls through errorDescribedBy; no duplicate group error association.

families.props: label; name; value; id?; description?
families.behaviour: Native radio props/ref, checked/defaultChecked/onChange; group error belongs to Fieldset.

families.props: label; name; value; id?; description?; error?; indeterminate=false
families.behaviour: Native checkbox props/ref, checked/defaultChecked/onChange; indeterminate separate from checkedness; no readOnly.

families.props: title; description?; errors: {id,text,targetId,contextId?}[]; focusRequestKey?
families.behaviour: Native h2/ul/li/a; document-order sorting and issue deduplication after commit. New focusRequestKey requests focus once; passive display omits the key. Prefix/restore document title, retain fragments and scroll label/legend before native-control focus. No alert/live role by default.

families.props: label; name; min?; max?; required positive finite step; value/defaultValue raw strings; onValueChange(raw,{source}); incrementLabel; decrementLabel; formatValueAnnouncement?
families.behaviour: Native number-input ref and stepping; shared required/optional/error policy; native reset for uncontrolled values; boundary disables and focus fallback; one polite button-change announcer. No readonly, placeholder, custom spinbutton semantics or second value owner.

families.props: legend; name prefix; id?; raw value/defaultValue {day,month,year}; onValueChange(next,{part}); helperText?; error?; errorAssociation=group|children; nonempty invalidParts for children; required=true; disabled; readOnly; purpose=date|date-of-birth; labels?; partNames?; optionalLabel?
families.behaviour: Native fieldset with three text inputs; day ref; numeric inputmode; raw strings preserved and native uncontrolled reset. getDateInputIds(id) returns group/day/month/year; supplied form owner applies to all parts. Consumer validates explicitly; no parsing/clamping/auto-advance.

families.props: open; onOpenChange(next,{reason}); title or accessibleLabel; showTitle; showClose; closeLabel; size=small|medium|large; presentation=inset|fullscreen (mobile); headingLevel=2..6; dismissal=dismissible|forced-decision; children (Content); actions; returnFocusRef
families.behaviour: Controlled native showModal/ref; container autofocus with compatibility fallback; one tabbable boundary handler; explicit close requests; forced decisions require enabled resolving actions. Restore page overflow and return focus. No native open attribute API.

families.props: Dialog-owned ::backdrop CSS; no public React component
families.behaviour: Own public design contract retained; no extra presentation element or focus target required.

families.props: state=info; titleText; descriptionText?; headingLevel=none|2..6; announcement=none|polite|assertive (none); stateLabels?; ref=HTMLDivElement; container metadata only
families.behaviour: Static nonfocusable div by default; fixed decorative icon and one hidden state prefix; explicit semantic headings use matching responsive tokens. Optional description omits blank text. Live priority is independent of state; one announcement owner, no focus or lifetime management.

families.props: label; tone=neutral|info|success|warning|error (neutral); ref=HTMLSpanElement; container metadata only
families.behaviour: Noninteractive span; visible label supplies meaning; no hidden tone prefix, role/live region, event handlers or content slots. Small-body text wraps within min(parent width,15rem).

families.props: label|labelledBy; items: {id,label,heading,content}[] (minimum 2); headingLevel=3 (2..6); selectedId/defaultSelectedId; onSelectedChange; activation=automatic|manual (automatic)
families.behaviour: Linked-section SSR/baseline; measured enhancement at >=48rem if whole row fits. Automatic/manual activation, one roving entry, mounted hidden panels, focus-aware fallback/re-enhancement and all-sections print. Controlled owner may decline; never hide focused content.

families.props: items: {id,title,content}[]; headingLevel (2..6); titleStyle?; expandedIds/defaultExpandedIds; onExpandedChange; panelLandmark=false
families.behaviour: Independent expansion; ordinary headings and all content visible for SSR/no-JS; native buttons after enhancement; retain panel DOM, protect initial focus, recover focused panel before external collapse. Explicit headingLevel; visual style independent. Consumer reveals before focus.

families.props: layout=vertical|horizontal; title?; headingLevel=none; titleStyle=auto|compact; titleHref?; titleLinkAttributes?; wholeCardClickable=false; image?; children?; actions?; imageBadge?
families.behaviour: Ordinary div ref; semantic title and compact visual heading independent; intrinsic image and one Badge; container-responsive layout. Surface enhancement delegates completed eligible pointer activation to the real title link, preserving native controls, selection and cancellation. SSR retains native links.

families.props: label=Breadcrumb; ancestors: {id,label,href,linkAttributes?}[]; currentPage?; expanded/defaultExpanded=false; onExpandedChange; showFullPathLabel; showCompactPathLabel
families.behaviour: Native named nav ref, complete ordered ancestors and optional plain current text. Measured compact overflow, native scrolling, persistent expanded preference, retained nodes/focused toggle, full wrapping SSR/print. Controlled expanded requires onExpandedChange; otherwise defaultExpanded.

families.props: label=Pagination; currentPage; exact totalPages; pageHref(page); presentation=auto|numbered|compact; labels?; linkAttributes(page)?; onNavigate(page,{href,source})?; pageJump=false; pageJump=true requires jumpForm={action,pageName,hiddenFields?}
families.behaviour: Native nav ref; bounded seven-position window and real current href; measured compact layout defers while a numbered link is focused. Optional page entry validates whole ASCII integers, focuses errors and announces current-page no-op. Explicit native GET fallback retains filters; application owns results, history and success focus.

families.props: ToastProvider: regionLabel, emptyText, stateLabels, formatCountLabel, formatAnnouncement, onDismiss(id); required ToastRegion and ToastNotificationsButton; useToast(): add(message):id, dismiss(id); message={id,state=info,titleText,descriptionText?,announcement=polite,dismissLabel}
families.behaviour: One document/app-shell owner; empty implicit status/alert announcers; 50ms delivery batching only; chronological persistent in-flow list; duplicate active ID rejected; scoped dismissal with focus recovery; defer both announcement channels during native modals; no duration or eviction.

families.props: code:string; label:string; copyable=true; labels?; onCopy(code)?; wrapper div ref
families.behaviour: Exact pre/code text; progressive copy; persistent polite feedback; measured named overflow; wrapping SSR/print fallback. Manual screen-reader and Figma/token-sync acceptance pending.

families.props: SideMenu: optional aria-label (nonempty if supplied; distinct names for multiple navigation purposes); items with static or expandable Accordion groups; currentId?; headingLevel=2..6 required for expandable groups (static-only may use none); expandedIds/onExpandedChange or defaultExpandedIds. ResponsiveSideMenu adds required visible drawer title label independent of nav aria-label; controlled open/onOpenChange, mobilePresentation=drawer|inline, inlineHeadingLevel=2..5 required for inline, toggleLabel, closeLabel, returnFocusRef. Optional drawerTriggerContainer: mounted same-document HTMLElement for primary header placement.
families.behaviour: Native nav refs. Reuses neutral Accordion for groups and the outer in-flow Menu, existing Link/Button/Dialog, and shared filled selected current-page states. Explicit heading hierarchy and independent inner/outer ownership. Drawer alignment removes compounded padding. App owns routing and destination focus. Zero core nav padding or divider; host page owns separation. Primary drawer Button can render in a header slot, with focus return to that actual trigger; section/inline controls remain local.
